messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — OrbitCloud SI wants to co-sell via marketplace + joint announcement. Need clear lead-hand off and account mapping rules. Who owns pipeline motion once a joint demo is scheduled?
Maya: thanks. do we have an intake form for marketplace leads?  
Ricardo: yes — intake lives on Confluence (https://confluence.internal/redwood/si-intake). default: SI owns first 30 days of outreach unless account is existing Redwood AE owned.
Sam: can we codify that as: SI owns opportunity until pipeline stage 2 unless AE claims within 48h? :thinking:
Alyssa: exactly. propose: "SI-Primary" tag + owner_email on intake. AE claim window = 48h after intake. if unclaimed, SI progresses.
Ricardo: add rule: if ACV>250k or strategic account (see strategic-accounts list), auto-escalate to enterprise AE and notify sales@redwood.com.
partners-bot: Intake form created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/si-intake. Reminder: please add 'marketplace_listing' checkbox for joint announce gating. :white_check_mark:
Maya: deployment notes: if listing requires HW partner credits, mark field 'hw_partner' and include partner contact.
Alyssa: for joint announcements: 1) PR draft 2) legal review 3) SI + partner exec signoff. timeline target = 3 weeks.
Sam: mapping snippet i shared earlier:
```
account,owner,status,touch_type
acme-corp,si@orbitcloud.com,SI-Primary,post-demo
bigbank,ae@redwood.com,AE-Claimed,pre-demo
```
Ricardo: workflow for marketplace gating: marketplace ops reviews listing; if SI requests co-branding, ops routes to marketing for asset check.
Alyssa: action items: Maya — update intake + add 48h claim rule; Ricardo — add ACV threshold automation; Sam — update confluence with mapping CSV example; I'll draft joint announce checklist.
Maya: on it. ping if you need the intake schema.
partners-bot: Note logged: 1730000360 - tasks created in Asana (partners/si-onboarding).
